# typocasual

> A contact sheet. Every frame printed at the same size, nothing ranked.

A static single-page site: a contact sheet of 20 frames — 12 generated
concrete plates, 4 type specimens and 4 text cards. Served as static
assets by a Cloudflare Worker. No server-side rendering, no CMS, no build step.

Tagline: a structure, left out in the weather

## Machine-readable

- [data.json](https://typotypocasual.victroyarroyo.workers.dev/data.json) — every frame, filter and outbound link. The source of truth.
- [data.schema.json](https://typotypocasual.victroyarroyo.workers.dev/data.schema.json) — JSON Schema describing the shape of data.json.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/veekdur/typocasual-website/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — how to edit this site.

## A note on `growth`

Every frame carries a `growth` value from 0 to 1. It is this site's own concept:
how long the frame has been out in the weather, not a rating or a ranking. It
drives how much moss covers the frame — 0 is bare concrete, 1 is buried. Frames
are filtered by `kind` (`all`, `plate`, `spec`, `note`).
